items.headline: Vance blames Obama administration for Iowa lead-azide threat after Army detonation; credits Stephen Miller
items.summary: Speaking at Wright-Patterson AFB, Vance said the unstable lead azide was stored in Iowa in 2009 “with no real plan” and the administration chose a controlled detonation over the risk of an uncontrolled one. Critics noted Trump held office four years after Obama (Daily Beast: “widely mocked”); on X Vance credited Chief of Staff Stephen Miller’s “leadership” (16.3K likes, 962K views).
items.engagement: 5,672 likes · 626 RTs · 518 replies · 293 quotes · 2.18M views (Rupar clip)

items.headline: Vance says Jensen Huang won’t need a pardon as scrutiny of Nvidia scandal builds in Washington
items.summary: After President Trump said he’d be willing to grant one, Vance told reporters in Ohio, “I don’t think he needs a pardon at all… I haven’t seen any evidence, again, that he committed a crime,” adding that DOJ and national-security officials told him the reinstated Nvidia CEO is not under investigation.
items.engagement: 798 likes · 120 RTs · 125 replies · 14 quotes · 153.2K views (@FoxNews clip)

items.headline: Vance and the Second Family serve Thanksgiving meals to troops at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base
items.summary: In his home state of Ohio, Vance, Second Lady Usha Vance and the Second Family served Thanksgiving meals to Airmen and Guardians and sat down with service members for a meal; @VP’s clip of Usha Vance speaking with troops drew 333K views.
